title: Harden watcher lock interruption and EPIPE regression coverage
description: The watcher cannot process Ctrl+C while blocked in the synchronous board lock. The existing child-ignores-stdin test does not reliably force EPIPE; add a large-input regression test. Found in the second Opus review.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Make lock waits interruptible or provide an effective forced shutdown, and verify it.
Test an action that exits without reading enough stdin to force EPIPE.
